authority: @tileflow/core resolvedTileflowMapSchema and tileflowCaptureSceneSchema (input); authoring branches are generated from their shared fields
description: Generated machine-readable reference for writing and inspecting one singular Tileflow map. The document root is the authoring schema.
x-tileflow-refinement-contract: Standard JSON Schema keywords encode every representable constraint. x-tileflow-refinements records the remaining relational checks enforced by the same Core parser and tileflow validate.

strategies.atomic: The nearest declaration replaces the complete inherited value.
strategies.deep: Plain objects merge recursively; arrays and non-objects replace atomically.
strategies.icons: Omission inherits; any declared array replaces atomically; [] selects no icon directories.
strategies.identity: The leaf map owns the value; it is never inherited.
strategies.leaf: Tooling metadata is read only from the leaf and is never inherited.
strategies.lineage: Defines or traverses the map lineage and is removed from the resolved design.
strategies.modules: Each declared module domain replaces that complete domain; omitted domains inherit.
strategies.text-assets: One declaration atomically replaces the inherited text provider and removes the other provider kind.

x-tileflow-theme-contract.authority: @tileflow/core defineTheme, resolvedTileflowMapSchema, category-safe style schemas, and theme audit

identity.selector: Each themes object key is the concrete runtime selector used in manifests, URLs, builds, captures, and receipts.
identity.document: theme.id and theme.version are editorial/provenance identity and may differ from the selector key.
identity.system: system is reserved for browser selection policy and is never a concrete theme name or compiled artifact key.

relationalRules.rule: Must name an own entry of themes.
Every theme on one map must expose exactly the same token keys in every category.
Each declared selector must exist in themes and its theme.colorScheme must match the system key.
Unknown, cyclic, and cross-category token references are rejected before style compilation.
Token categories must match their visual slot directly, in zoom stops, and in expression outputs.

implicitLiterals.effect: inspect reports the exact semantic path; createStyle, validate, preview, build, and capture fail closed.
inspect reports the exact semantic path; compilation remains valid because ordinary numeric styling is common.

authoring.description: Exactly one of root or extends. In TypeScript, extends normally receives an imported map object; scenes belong only to the leaf definition.

resolved.role: validate, inspect, build, and compiler input after inheritance
resolved.description: Standalone map with a required name and root, without extends or scenes.

TileflowAuthoringMap.description: The singular map exported by tileflow.config.ts: exactly one root or derived map definition.

TileflowRootMap.description: Compiler-owned root passed to defineRootMap(). It declares root and cannot declare extends.

fonts.description: Ordered local font directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces either text provider, and [] explicitly selects no provider for a text-free map.

glyphs.description: One explicit PBF glyph provider. In authoring, declaration atomically replaces inherited fonts or glyphs; fonts and glyphs are mutually exclusive.

icons.description: Ordered icon directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces, [] selects no icons, and a later directory wins by exact canonical ID.

TileflowDerivedMap.description: Ordinary map passed to defineMap(). It extends an imported map object and cannot declare root.

fonts.description: Ordered local font directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces either text provider, and [] explicitly selects no provider for a text-free map.

glyphs.description: One explicit PBF glyph provider. In authoring, declaration atomically replaces inherited fonts or glyphs; fonts and glyphs are mutually exclusive.

icons.description: Ordered icon directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces, [] selects no icons, and a later directory wins by exact canonical ID.

TileflowMapScene.description: Leaf-owned capture scene. Its map id is implicit from the containing map and must not be declared.

oneOf.description: Bounds camera. South must be less than north; west and east must define a non-empty span.

x-tileflow-refinements.rule: south < north and west !== east

viewport.description: Logical viewport. Physical width and height (logical dimension multiplied by dpr) are each at most 4096.

oneOf.description: Application capture target. captureId and selector are mutually exclusive.

ResolvedTileflowMap.description: Standalone compiler input after inheritance. Tooling scenes and extends are no longer present.

fonts.description: Ordered local font directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces either text provider, and [] explicitly selects no provider for a text-free map.

glyphs.description: One explicit PBF glyph provider. In authoring, declaration atomically replaces inherited fonts or glyphs; fonts and glyphs are mutually exclusive.

icons.description: Ordered icon directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces, [] selects no icons, and a later directory wins by exact canonical ID.

x-tileflow-refinements.rule: When both values exist, minZoom must be less than or equal to maxZoom.
For direct vector tiles, minzoom must be less than or equal to maxzoom.
West must be less than east and south must be less than north.
Every exact font face name must already be Unicode NFC.
Each exact key must already be Unicode NFC.
Each value must equal its canonical WHATWG HTTP(S) origin and contain no path, credentials, query, fragment, or redundant trailing slash/default port.
Literal pattern widths must be strictly increasing.
Must be a safe WHATWG HTTP(S) DEM template containing each of {z}, {x}, and {y} exactly once.
The index interval must be greater than or equal to, and a whole multiple of, the minor interval.
Every minor interval must satisfy the zoom- and multiplier-dependent main-thread contour density budget.
The source range must cover its threshold zooms, minZoom must not exceed maxZoom, and overzoom must not produce a negative DEM zoom.
Each layer range must begin at or after the effective contour-source minZoom and include its own effective minZoom.
minzoom must be less than or equal to maxzoom.
West < east and south < north when bounds is present.

__schema11.description: Portable lowercase kebab-case identifier; prototype keys and reserved Windows filenames are forbidden.

__schema13.description: Canonical HTTP(S) origin only: no path, credentials, query, fragment, trailing slash, controls, or whitespace.
__schema13.x-tileflow-refinement: Must equal the canonical WHATWG URL origin.

__schema14.description: Ordered local font directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces either text provider, and [] explicitly selects no provider for a text-free map.

anyOf.description: Canonical config-relative directory beginning with ./ or one or more ../ segments; no empty, dot, dot-dot, backslash, or control segments.

path.description: Portable package-relative directory with non-empty segments and no dot, dot-dot, or backslash segments.

anyOf.description: Package-owned asset descriptor. Prefer importing the descriptor exported by its owning package.

fontStacks.description: Unique exact comma-joined MapLibre request keys, in NFC, without surrounding whitespace, controls, slash, or backslash.

url.description: Exact HTTP(S), root-relative, or path-relative glyph URL containing {fontstack} and {range}; no credentials, fragment, backslash, or controls.

__schema16.description: Complete standalone glyph provider owned by the map: an explicit URL template plus every exact MapLibre font-stack request key it uses.

__schema17.description: Exact NFC MapLibre font-stack request key.

__schema18.description: Ordered icon directories. In authoring, omission inherits, declaration atomically replaces, [] selects no icons, and a later directory wins by exact canonical ID.

fallbacks.description: Unique exact fallback face names or CSS generic families.

__schema103.description: Exact NFC OpenType full name, exact glyph stack ID, or CSS generic; no surrounding whitespace, controls, or backslash.

x-tileflow-refinements.rule: Values must be strictly increasing.
Must pass the exact safe HTTP(S) DEM-template parser described on the property.
When present, must include the greatest threshold zoom.
When present, must not precede the smallest threshold zoom and must not exceed the effective maxZoom.
Must not exceed the smallest threshold zoom, so generated DEM zooms cannot become negative.
Each layer minZoom must not precede the effective contour-source minZoom, and each layer maxZoom must include its effective minZoom.

__schema152.description: Safe HTTP(S) DEM tile template containing each of {z}, {x}, and {y} exactly once; credentials, fragments, protocol-relative URLs, backslashes, controls, and non-loopback plain HTTP are forbidden.
__schema152.x-tileflow-refinement: Must pass the exact Core DEM-template parser, including WHATWG URL and loopback checks.

__schema171.description: One to 25 zoom-indexed [minor, index] elevation intervals; zoom keys are integers from 0 through 24.

x-tileflow-refinements.rule: The index interval must be greater than or equal to, and a whole multiple of, the minor interval.
The minor interval must satisfy the zoom- and multiplier-dependent main-thread contour density budget.

__schema180.description: Exact NFC OpenType full name, exact glyph stack ID, or CSS generic; no surrounding whitespace, controls, or backslash.

__schema181.description: Unique exact fallback face names or CSS generic families.

scene___schema0.description: Portable lowercase kebab-case identifier; prototype keys and reserved Windows filenames are forbidden.

scene___schema12.description: Exact root-relative application path without origin, credentials, fragment, backslash, controls, or surrounding whitespace.

scene___schema14.description: Non-empty CSS selector after trimming surrounding whitespace.
